reason: 该插件主要用于把飞书/Lark 聊天与 Pi 或 DeepSeek Harness 连接成桥接通道，实现消息、附件、会话与命令在两侧的同步与交互，因此分类为“外部服务”。依据仓库描述与清单可见其核心在于聊天集成、会话路由、运行时命令控制及本地配置/状态文件管理，不属于代码生成或纯开发调试类插件。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于将飞书/Lark 聊天与 Pi 或 DeepSeek Harness 打通，实现对话消息、附件和控制指令在聊天与本地智能体之间的同步与转换。
summaries.en: This plugin connects Feishu/Lark chat with Pi or DeepSeek Harness so users can route messages, attachments, and control commands between chat and the local agent.

capabilities: Bridges Feishu/Lark chat events with Pi/DSH agent sessions
Supports private and group chat routing with per-topic/session context
Accepts chat attachments and forwards interactive card content
Provides runtime controls via chat commands and environment/config settings
Runs local webhook/WS callback handling for card actions

reasons.code: README states configuration uses Feishu/Lark App ID and Secret plus FEISHU_* / HARNESS_* environment variables for bridge setup.
Package metadata exports Pi and harness adapter entry points and declares a Pi extension and DSH bundle integration.
README describes attachment handling for images and code/text files, as well as interactive card parsing before sending context to the agent.
README documents webhook/card callback host, path, and port settings, indicating external API interaction and local listener configuration.
README lists local config/state files (for credentials, session mapping, runtime overrides, logs) under agent directories.
